methode: Même base et mêmes données ; 1 exécution de chauffe puis 15 mesures, médiane retenue. « Avant » : anciennes vues GROUP BY et pas de trigger de solde.

detail_avant.sql: SELECT sku,lot_code,location_code,qty,available_qty FROM v_stock WHERE article_id=? AND owner_id=? AND zone_id=? ORDER BY lot_code,location_code LIMIT 20

detail_apres.sql: SELECT sku,lot_code,location_code,qty,available_qty FROM v_stock WHERE article_id=? AND owner_id=? AND zone_id=? ORDER BY lot_code,location_code LIMIT 20

detail_avant.sql: SELECT receipt_item_id,location_id,available_qty,expires_on FROM v_stock WHERE article_id=? AND available_qty>0 AND blocked=0 AND (expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on>=?) ORDER BY expires_on IS NULL,expires_on,received_at,receipt_item_id,location_id LIMIT 20

detail_apres.sql: SELECT receipt_item_id,location_id,available_qty,expires_on FROM v_stock WHERE article_id=? AND available_qty>0 AND blocked=0 AND (expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on>=?) ORDER BY expires_on IS NULL,expires_on,received_at,receipt_item_id,location_id LIMIT 20

detail_avant.sql: SELECT l.code,u.used_kg,u.used_pallets FROM v_location l JOIN v_location_usage u ON u.id=l.id JOIN article a ON a.id=? WHERE l.storage=a.storage AND l.width_m>=a.width_m AND l.height_m>=a.height_m AND l.depth_m>=a.depth_m AND u.used_kg+?*a.unit_kg<=l.max_kg AND u.used_m3+?*a.width_m*a.height_m*a.depth_m<=l.capacity_m3 AND u.used_pallets+?/a.units_per_pallet<=l.max_pallets

detail_apres.sql: SELECT l.code,u.used_kg,u.used_pallets FROM v_location l JOIN v_location_usage u ON u.id=l.id JOIN article a ON a.id=? WHERE l.storage=a.storage AND l.width_m>=a.width_m AND l.height_m>=a.height_m AND l.depth_m>=a.depth_m AND u.used_kg+?*a.unit_kg<=l.max_kg AND u.used_m3+?*a.width_m*a.height_m*a.depth_m<=l.capacity_m3 AND u.used_pallets+?/a.units_per_pallet<=l.max_pallets

detail_avant.sql: SELECT l.zone_name,SUM(u.used_kg),SUM(l.max_kg),SUM(u.used_pallets),SUM(l.max_pallets) FROM v_location l JOIN v_location_usage u ON u.id=l.id GROUP BY l.zone_id,l.zone_name

detail_apres.sql: SELECT l.zone_name,SUM(u.used_kg),SUM(l.max_kg),SUM(u.used_pallets),SUM(l.max_pallets) FROM v_location l JOIN v_location_usage u ON u.id=l.id GROUP BY l.zone_id,l.zone_name

detail_avant.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(delta) FROM v_stock_movement WHERE receipt_item_id=? AND location_id=?),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM pick WHERE receipt_item_id=? AND location_id=? AND status IN ('planned','confirmed')),0)

detail_apres.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT qty-reserved_qty FROM stock_balance WHERE receipt_item_id=? AND location_id=?),0)
